notes.title: Source Code Release
notes.notes:
Greetings players, as the title says I am releasing the games source code for people to look at and utilise for modding.


How to Access the Source Code
The source code can be accessed by right clicking the game, accessing the properties and heading to betas. To gain access to the private beta you must enter the password "AgentAccessConfirmed" without the quotation marks. Then you should see the branch. 



Warning, this branch does not include the game files and only includes the source files for the code, meaning that you will have to swap back to the regular game branch to be able to play the game again.



After downloading the branch you can browse the files by right clicking the game again, hitting manage and browsing the local files.


What is included
C++ source files for game project code

Blueprints

Levels
What isn't included
Unreal Project files 

Assets

Unreal Engine Code

Unreal Plugins


Licence for the code
I left a readme in the code, though this distribution does fall under Unreal Engines EULA since it is technically an example project. As for how I want people to use the code, it should only really be used to help with making mods for Constantine Scores. However, ultimately what people do with the code is out of my control. 


The future of the game
Due to personal reasons I don't plan on ever updating the game again, mostly due to my mental health. However, I wanted to leave the players one last thing before I left. Unreal modding is hard and I hope that giving out the source code might help people understand what goes on behind the game. It's a jank game with very jank code. Honestly, I enjoyed working on the game and I hope you all enjoyed it too.

notes.title: Constantine Scores Update 1.7
notes.notes:
Welcome to update 1.7. This update I wanted to be as big as update 1.5, and I hope you all enjoy it.

Campaign Reworking
Campaigns have been changed in this update. Before, contracts would be selected based on a type (small, medium or large), however could be repeated. With the new change, contracts have been split into seperate lists to avoid duplicates. As well, more longer missions will show up for advanced and expert campaigns. The campaign feature changes haven't been fully tested, so let me know what you think about the change.


Contracts
Four new contracts will be added to the game, included as single missions and campaign missions.

Penthouse
Penthouse is a medium sized mission, tasking you with eliminating politicians of Constantines Government

Cyber Den
Cyber Den is a large sized missions, tasking you with robbing a hidden research centre. Eliminate the researchers and secure the data.

Syn Casino
Syn Casino is a large mission, tasking you with robbing a vault full of cash. This mission has extensive layout randomisation to keep it fresh on replays.

Syn Resort
Syn Resort is a large mission, tasking you with robbing a vault full of cash. This mission has extensive layout randomisation to keep it fresh on replays.

Strongholds
Two new strongholds have been added to the game.

Stronghold Park
Stronghold Store


Weapons 
More primary weapons have been added to the game.

Akimbo RAC-M
Akimbo RS9-X
Akimbo VK15
Akimbo AP8-X


Soundtrack

Another reminder that the soundtrack releases later this month on the 22nd.

notes.title: Constantine Scores Update 1.6.1
notes.notes:
Welcome players to another new update, again a smaller one. In this update you can expect to see a lot of new achievements.

Special Packages
The director ordered insiders to leave behind dead drops, you can expect to find them on contracts, though they might be hidden. Try searching for any drops with an armor insignia on them. Retrieving a package will reward you with currency and an achievement.

Tweaks and Fixes

Buffed Recovery and Powered Up Augments healing to be percentage based.
Doubled EXP reward for playing campaigns.
Reduced Thermite timer on Skyscraper.
Fixed Cartel Yacht not showing up in campaigns.
Increased health regen rate of the Healing Cannon.
Tweaked AI movement when attacking the player.
Changed gunfire audio to reduce sound overlapping.

notes.title: Constantine Scores Update 1.6
notes.notes:
Hello, welcome to update 1.6, this is a smaller updated compared to the previous one and is mostly here to address fixes while providing some quality of life additions to the game.


Augments
Four new augments have been added.

Recovery Augment (Head Slot)
Increased Health Regen. Using your Alt attacks regens health on use.

Precision Augment(Torso) 
Weapons have reduced spread and deal more damage.

Deflector Augment (Arms) 
Increased dodge, melee weapons deal more damage.

Powered Up Augment (Legs) 
Increased movement speed, using your ability regens health when first activated.


Health Cannon
A new alt attack has been added, prioritising healing over damage, as it shoots healing gas that lasts ten seconds.

Weapons
Two new secondary weapons have been added and one of the previous secondaries has been changed.


AP8-X changed to an auto pistol.
Added B90-S a burst variant of the B90.
Added VK15-S a burst variant of the VKI5.




Difficulty Reworking
The balance of the game have been reworked once more, mostly focusing on trying to scale each difficulty close to each other. Listed below are the changes.

Tweaked health of enemies, on expert difficulty and above.
Reduced assault wave length on higher difficulties.
Increased EXP Boost for playing on Master difficulty.
Slightly slowed enemy spawn rates on higher difficulties


Fixes


Fixed visual bugs on stronghold military base.
Fixed flares being affected by difficulty timer.
Fixed tanks tear gas not hurting the player.
Fixed abilities menu button playing the wrong sound.
Changed cartel shredders throwing range for molotovs.
Fixed FOV not updating when changing settings in game.
Fixed Pistolero fire rates to also apply to auto firing pistols.
Added a delay to reloading weapons when switching to a new gun.

notes.title: Constantine Scores Update 1.5
notes.notes:
Hello players, the new update is out with a bunch of new content, and fixes. Listed below are all the new additions for you to expect. I hope you enjoy it.

Contracts
Three new contracts will be added to the game, included as single missions and campaign missions.

Turf War
Turf War is a small mission, tasking you with eliminating Orion Cartel members and securing loot either from armoured transports or crates. Small missions such as these are made with the intention of adding more variety to the campaign mode.

Datacenter
Datacenter is a medium mission, tasking you with stealing valuable data from Constantines Government. This mission has more in-depth randomisation when it comes to its objectives, as it features multiple alternative objectives similar to Cartel Mansion, Police Station or Syn Suburbia. 

Cartel Yacht
Cartel Yacht is a long mission, tasking you with robbing a valuable yachts vault full of gold and cash. Expect heavy resistance and a new environment that takes you outside of urban combat.


Strongholds
Strongholds are a new game type added to the game. Featuring three maps. Strongholds are a holdout mode focusing on transferring data to your employers. Each data transferred will reward you with money and increase the difficulty slightly. You can choose to stay around or leave early. Be warned as enemies will deal more damage the more you progress.

Shotgun Rework 
Shotguns have been reworked to make them slightly less viable at longer ranges. They now have increased spread and deal slightly less damage, incentivizing them to be used more at medium ranges.

Dual Wielding 
Akimbos have been added to the roster of weapons. They will be purchasable as a primary slot weapon and are affected by previous armor sets. Four have been added to the game, listed below.
 

Akimbo 9A-S
Akimbo RS9
Akimbo Reagle
Akimbo Gris


Armors
Two new armors have been added to the game.

MK4 Strength
Melee weapons penetrate shields and deal more damage.

MK4 Pistolero
Semi and fully auto pistols or revolvers shoot faster and deal more damage.

Armor Changes
Armors have a hidden stat that give damage resistance. This stat for MK4 armors was universally set to 25% bonus, however in this update it has been reduced down to a 5% bonus. All armors except for the starter armor now only grant a 5% resistance bonus to taking damage.


Changes and Fixes  

Buffed the 9A-S.
Fixed Gris not having muzzle effects when shooting.
Changed npcs that spawn on Cartel Mansion.
Added more npc variants to summer pedestrians
Fixed bug with operator rank giving the wrong total ammo for secondaries.
Fixed bug with ammo augment giving the wrong total ammo for secondaries.
Tweaked melee ai behaviors and damage.
Tweaked friendly ai behaviors.
Added friendlies to Cartel Clubhouse and changed the contract description to indicate it.
Changed player melee damages and hitboxes.
Removed floating posters on truck convoy.
Tweaked health for cartel tanks.
Changed melee augments to give bonus damage towards headshots	.
Fixed friendly ai taking explosive/fire damage from player. 
Shotgun armors now give a small bonus to shotgun weapon damage.
Fixed cartel shields not taking cover when their shields break.

notes.title: Constantine Scores Update 1.4
notes.notes:
Greetings players, this update will be a smaller one compared to the previous major updates. In this update, you will see changes to how the difficulty is handled as well as more gameplay choices for players to mess around with.



Difficulty Overhaul
The difficulty of the game has been tweaked and rebalanced. A few of the main changes are to how fast it takes for enemies to show up during the initial assault, and time based objectives changing based on difficulty. Listed below are the changes.



 Special enemies arrive faster to the scene.
 Reduced health drops on special enemies on higher difficulties.
 Tweaked ai aggression when engaging enemies at longer distances.
 Increase objective timers on Expert difficulty and above.



Abilities
Two new abilities have been added to the game.

Suppressor
Weapons have Infinite ammo and deal more damage.

Escape Artist
Move faster and have increased dodge chance.


Augments
Four new augments have been added to the game.

Jump Back (Head Slot)
Increased dodge, dodging damage heals back health.

Regen Augmentation (Torso) 
Increased health and regen rate.

Speed Reloader (Arms) 
Increased dodge, reload weapons slightly faster

Athletic Augmentation (Legs) 
Increased movement speed and health regen.


Weapons
One new weapon has been added to the game. The Striker, a fully automatic rifle that fires explosive rounds. It packs a punch, though lacks the ammo pools that other rifles have.


Changes and Fixes
 Reduced Ability timer from 7 seconds to 5 seconds to properly to reflect UI indicator.
 Added friendly team mates to Prison Transport.
 Fixed some UI typos.




That's all for now. This update is smaller compared to previous updates due to moving to a new computer. Hope you enjoy the update.

notes.title: Constantine Scores Update 1.3
notes.notes:
Welcome players to Update 1.3, I hope you enjoy the content, as after this update I will be taking a small break from the game. I won't stop updating the game entirely, however big updates will be less frequent.

Contracts
Three new contracts have been added to the game, as well as achievements. They can be accessed directly through playing them as single missions or appearing as random contracts during campaigns. Syn Suburbia and Police Station utilise addition RNG by having limited variant objectives that can appear during the mission.

Truck Convoy
Truck Convoy is a small sized mission, Orion Cartel are being ambushed by the police, take advantage of this situation.

Syn Suburbia
Syn Suburbia is a medium sized mission, Syn executives live in a house in the suburbs, head there and secure the loot within.

Police Station
Police Station is a large sized mission, rescue an informant that's being interrogated by the police force.


Armors

MK4 Blitz
A shotgun variant armor that increases the players shooting and reloading speed.

MK4 Sentry
A burst and precision variant armor that increases the players shooting speed and damage.

MK4 Heavy
A automatic variant armor that increases ammo capacity and reloading speed.


Fixes and changes

 Fixed flares using the wrong timer value.
 Fixed armor typo for technician armor.
 Changed sound for drill breaking, increasing its volume distance.

notes.title: Constantine Scores Update 1.21
notes.notes:
Hello, I hope you all enjoyed the recent missions added. This update is a smaller one made to tackle a few issues with the game.



Difficulty Reworkings
In order to tackle difficulty of the game a few changes have been made to make the game more user friendly.

 Players take less damage on regular difficulty.
 Cartel stalkers have a distinct color pallet.
 Increased reward modifiers for harder difficulties.
 Police tanks have significantly smaller shield sizes.
 Police tanks covering face animation has been modified slightly.



UI Reworkings
The in game player UI has been reworked after visual feedback from a user named Punished Bernadetta.

 Changed money indicator text color to green.
 Moved text indicators for key bindings and gave them a bright vibrant teal color.
 Changed recharge bars to have individual colors and image icons
 Modified health bar icons background to be a dark red instead of white when health is depleted.
 Changed lives text color from red to white.
 Modified success menus button layout.
 Modified augment menu's size to fix text being cut off.

notes.title: Constantine Scores Update 1.2
notes.notes:
Greetings players! Welcome to Update 1.2. This update initially releasing for February is coming out now! Listed below are the new additions and changes coming out in this patch.


Contracts
Two new contracts are added in this update, both featured in campaign, with achievements tied to completing them.

Military Base
Military base is a medium sized mission, take advantage of a chaotic war to secure missiles. 

Cartel Clubhouse
Cartel Clubhouse is a medium sized mission, assault a drug facility under the control of the Orion Cartel and steal their product.

Campaign Changes
The campaigns in the game have been changed due to feedback. Now selecting campaign options will also reward bonus modifiers to loot secured when playing. 

Regular 10% Bonus Reward
Advanced 20% Bonus Reward
Expert 30% Bonus Reward


Fixes and Changes

Added text indicators for slider values.
Changed snipers to have a red glow and glare for visibility purposes.
Changed faction snipers to have the same color pallet and model for visibility purposes.
Improved mouse sensitivity slider range.
Attempted fix for cursors not appearing during menus.
Changed pump shotguns fire rate to be its proper speed.
Attempted to fix game freezing when changing settings while in game.
Fixed interaction bar color mismatch.
Implemented mouse y invert option.
Fixed geometry in Jewellery Store.
Changed Armored Transports description and removed gangsters from spawning.
Reduced Timelock timer on Research Station from 210 seconds to 150 seconds.
Changed Drug transport color on Warehouse Robbery




Whats Next?
That is all for now. The next update can be expected to arrive some time in March. However, that will all be discussed in a future blog post.

notes.title: Feburary 2025 Update Announcement

Contracts

Experience two new contracts being added. They will be available to play as single missions as well as being added into the pool of missions that shows up in campaigns. Listed below are the two missions being added to the game.


Military Base
Cartel Clubhouse


More info on the contracts will be given on release.

Feedback changes.

With the feedback given from users on the discussion board, I plan on implementing a few changes, they will either release with the contracts or be in a smaller update later on. Listed below are community requested changes or features that will be addressed.

Mouse X/Y Invert
Increased Mouse sensitivity range
Sniper Visibility Changes
